What condition do my items have to be in?

We’ve got clear condition guidelines for the books, CD’s, DVD’s and games we will accept.

Check our full condition guidelines to make sure your book is suitable to sell. If we receive your book and it doesn’t meet our guidelines, we’ll give you the option to have it returned at cost, or recycle it for you. Read our full condition guidelines before selling.

View full condition guidelines

What condition do my items have to be in?

  • Fire or smoke damage
  • Tears to the cover or pages
  • Significant damage or tear to the binding
  • Water damage
  • Badly stained
  • Missing, loose or torn pages

  • Missing or wrong CD discs
  • Copied discs
  • CDs without the original packaging, artwork or instructions
  • Discs with cracks, deep scratches or that are misshapen
  • Have faulty or failed sound

  • Missing DVDs
  • Mismatched discs and cases
  • Pirated or copied DVDs
  • Are ex- rental copies
  • Discs without the original packaging, artwork or instructions
  • Discs with cracks, deep scratches or that are misshapen

  • Missing or wrong video game discs
  • Discs with cracks, dents, deep scratches or that are misshapen
  • Games with damaged or missing original packaging, artwork or instructions

Why sell books to WeBuyBooks?

WeBuyBooks should be your number one choice to sell books. Why? Because we’ll give you an instant cash offer and pay you the next day, as soon as we’ve received your books. That means there’s no hanging about waiting for buyers to find your books or haggling over bids. Sell it. Post it. Get paid.

Instant Valuation

Unlike other online selling sites, we’ll give you an instant cash offer for your book.Theres no waiting for buyers to bid on your books.

Free postage

Send all your books in one go with pre-paid postage, instead of sending them to multiple addresses.

Charity partners

When you sell books to us, you can choose to donate the value of that sale to one of our brilliant charity partners.

Next-day payment

Once we’ve received and checked your books, we’ll pay you the next day, so you can start spending that extra cash.

5% bonus

When you make any sale worth over £25, we’ll automatically increase your offer by 5%.

Sell various items

You can sell multiple books at once and you can also sell DVDs, CDs and video games as well. Talk about two birds, one stone!

Free collection

We can collect books from your home for free, which is especially useful when you want to sell books in bulk

We’re big on sustainability

We’re big on sustainability

Did you know that selling your old books online is a win-win for you and the environment? When someone else gets to enjoy your copy, it helps reduce pollution from making and shipping new books.

Here at WeBuyBooks, we're all about making a positive impact on the planet. That's why we've taken a recycling pledge! If your book doesn't quite meet our condition guidelines, don't worry. We'll either send it back to you at cost or recycle it responsibly. That way, none of our beloved books end up in a landfill. Join us in making a difference today!

WeBuyBooks saves a 30-acre forest each year!

Frequently asked questions

View all FAQs

It all depends on the book. For example, if you have a first edition copy of Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone, you’ve got a book that’s worth its weight in gold! However, if you’ve got a third edition reprint, the book’s value will be significantly less. The best way to know if your book is worth something is to keep an eye out for the print edition and use our calculator to get an instant valuation; then, you can decide if you’re happy with it and accept our offer.

The easiest way to find the value of old books is by entering your ISBN into your selling basket on our website or downloading our app and scanning the barcodes to get an instant cash valuation. Some books don’t have barcodes or ISBNs, so you can use the WeBuyBooks catalogue to get a valuation, or get in touch, and we’ll give you a personal valuation.

You should send your items within seven days of accepting our offer. If we haven’t received the items within 21 days, the price offered may not be valid, and upon receipt, we may adjust the amount to the current valuation

Once you’ve accepted our offer, you can print your free postage label at home, or we can send you one. All you need to do is label your boxes and send them via Evri. You can drop them at your local Evri parcel shop or arrange a home collection.
